run.subject: Which investors are politically exposed persons?
run.final_text: {"status": "refused", "answer": "I can't answer this: \"politically exposed person\" is not a term in the firm's ontology, so the question is out of scope. Searches for \"politically exposed person\", \"PEP\", \"political\", \"exposed\" and \"screening\" returned no terms. The nearest concept, xbpei:Clearance, is a decision on whether a party's tax documentation supports its treatment as an investor in a fund. It is not an AML/KYC or PEP screening, so I have not used it as a stand-in. No investor has been identified as a PEP or as not a PEP; that would have to come from the compliance/AML screening records, which sit outside this knowledge bundle.", "facts": [], "unknown": ["Whether any investor is a politically exposed person: the ontology has no such term, so this is not determined either way."], "conflicts": []}

result.label: Clearance
result.definition: A dated decision on whether a party's tax documentation supports its treatment as an investor in a fund vehicle, with the certifications and facts relied on and any open items. A renewed or withdrawn clearance is a new record; earlier records are kept.

result.label: clearanceOf
result.definition: The party the clearance is about.

result.label: reliesOnClearance
result.definition: The clearance whose validity on the payment date the determination relied on.

result.label: Case
result.definition: A unit of clearance work with an opening trigger and an outcome: onboarding, renewal, change in circumstances, or distribution.

result.label: Withholding Determination
result.definition: The treatment decided for one party and one distribution component: the outcome, the rate and its basis, the clearance relied on and the assessment that supports it.

result.label: caseKind
result.definition: Which kind of clearance work the case covers.

result.label: decides
result.definition: A clearance record produced by the case: granted, renewed, confirmed or withdrawn.
